thought.text: Ich erstelle jetzt das Monorepo mit Network-Layer und 2D-Client:

reasoning_content: Now I'll implement the 2D client. Let me create the packages step by step.

action.command:
python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
c = paramiko.SSHClient()
c.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
c.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')

# 1. Create core-network package
core_network = '''{
  "name": "@arelorian/core-network",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "type": "module",
  "main": "./dist/index.js",
  "types": "./dist/index.d.ts",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/index.js",
      "types": "./dist/index.d.ts"
    }
  },
  "scripts": {
    "build": "tsc",
    "dev": "tsc --watch"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "socket.io-client": "^4.7.4"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^20.11.0",
    "typescript": "^5.3.3"
  }
}
'''

sftp = c.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/tmp/core-network-package.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write(core_network)

# Create tsconfig
tsconfig = '''{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "ESNext",
    "moduleResolution": "bundler",
    "lib": ["ES2022"],
    "outDir": "./dist",
    "rootDir": "./src",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "declaration": true,
    "declarationMap": true,
    "sourceMap": true
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*"]
}
'''

with sftp.file('/tmp/tsconfig.json', 'w') as f:
    f.write(tsconfig)

c.exec_command('mkdir -p /opt/areloria/packages/core-network/src')

print("Package config created!")

c.close()
EOF
